## Load data + train/test split

```{r}
data = read.csv("02_llm/bills_prompts_responses_10000.csv")

data = data %>%
  filter(
    Model == "gpt-4o", 
    PromptingStrategyID==1) %>%
  select(
    Model, PromptingStrategyID, PromptingStrategyName,
    Chamber, Party, Year, Cong, Postal, State, Description, DW1, Major, MajorText, 
    MajorLLM, MajorTextLLM, ExplanationLLM) 

warnifnot(~any(is.na(data)))
```

## Multinomial Logisitic Regression

Currently, we use Major topic 20 as a reference level. 


### $f^\star$: 
```{r}
# get f* models for each feature V
model_unres = multinom(Major ~ 1, data=train)
# summary(model_unres)

model_res_chamber = multinom(Major ~ Chamber, data=train)
summary(model_res_chamber)
```
